title: MVP safety and confidence
purpose: Minimal, MVP-scoped safety layer: confidence is preserved end-to-end and no output implies a guarantee the system cannot give.
architecturalScope: Safety bounded context (MVP subset of todo.safety-confidence-engine). ConfidenceFusion + SafetySupervisor between guidance and speech.
domainContext: Confidence, ConfidenceScore, Observation, Uncertainty. Low confidence leads to STOP/reacquire/reassess.

milestones.title: Confidence pass-through
milestones.description: Every observation in the loop carries confidence and thresholds are enforced.

milestones.title: Phrasing guard
milestones.description: Outgoing messages are reviewed and downgraded when uncertain.

tasks.title: Enforce confidence from detector to speech
acceptanceCriteria: Low-confidence detections do not produce confident statements.

tasks.title: Implement guarantee-phrase guard
acceptanceCriteria: Automated test proves guarantee phrases cannot be emitted.
No spatial claim without evidence from validated perception.

risks.mitigation: Consistent uncertainty language; explicit 'I am not sure' states.

safetyImplications: This is the MVP safety boundary; strictest tests apply.
accessibilityImplications: Uncertainty must be spoken, never visual-only.
privacyImplications: No safety logs beyond ephemeral session state.

decisionLog.decision: Ship a minimal safety subset for the MVP and defer the full engine to todo.safety-confidence-engine.
decisionLog.rationale: The closed loop must be safe from day one without blocking on the complete engine.
